response.overview: Mavericks in California is described as a geographical freak of nature. Waves travelling thousands of miles across the Pacific collide with a steep underwater reef, forcing the wave energy into a towering wall of water - a terrifying paradise for surfers. All his life, big a wave surfer Alo Slebir has been obsessed with riding the perfect wave at this iconic location - but when it comes, how does he react?
response.title: Ride of a lifetime
